items.title: Rename all 8 koala-* signature salts to lattice-* via the worktree binary
items.context: koala-review-integrity-v1, koala-review-pass-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-workspace-binding-v1, koala-review-scope-binding-v1, koala-scope-check-integrity-v1, koala-finding-integrity-v1, koala-story-store in core/guard-utils.ts, machine.ts, process-fact-registry.ts, reviewer-status.ts, handlers/story-review.ts, canonical-story.ts, finding-verify.ts, review-run.ts, review-scope-binding.ts, handlers/scope-check.ts (+ their smokes). Change the literal salt VALUE; producers and consumers move together; sign this story's gates with the worktree binary.

happy.desc: git grep all 8 old koala-* salt strings (koala-review-integrity-v1, koala-review-pass-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-workspace-binding-v1, koala-review-scope-binding-v1, koala-scope-check-integrity-v1, koala-finding-integrity-v1, koala-story-store) in packages/*/src -> zero hits; WHY: confirms literal salt values are fully removed

git grep all 8 new lattice-* salt strings (lattice-review-integrity-v1, lattice-review-pass-integrity-v1, etc.) in the same files -> each appears exactly where its koala- predecessor did; WHY: confirms rename happened, not just deletion

run the existing smoke tests that exercise signature verification (guard-utils, machine, process-fact-registry, reviewer-status, story-review, canonical-story, finding-verify, review-run, review-scope-binding, scope-check smokes) -> all pass; WHY: producers and consumers use the same new salt, signatures still verify end-to-end

edge.desc: sign a gate artifact with the worktree binary after the rename, then verify it with the same binary -> signature valid; WHY: ensures the worktree build itself uses the new salts consistently (no stale dist cache)

check that no mixed old+new salt pair exists in any single file (e.g. producer writes koala-* but consumer reads lattice-*) -> zero mixed pairs; WHY: partial rename is worse than no rename (silent signature rejection)

adversarial.desc: verify that the residue-gate self-identifiers (KOALA_RESIDUE_* in review-preflight.ts) were NOT renamed by this item -- they must still say koala -> grep confirms KOALA_RESIDUE_* unchanged; WHY: renaming the gate that detects koala residue would break the residue gate itself (story 4 scope)
attempt to verify an artifact signed with the OLD koala-* salt using the new binary -> verification fails (rejects old salt); WHY: ensures no backward-compat path that silently accepts old signatures

check .lattice/story/ files are untouched (no salt rename leaked into story metadata or persisted evidence) -> git diff shows zero changes in .lattice/story/; WHY: story metadata uses different serialization; touching it would corrupt audit trail

items.title: Delete the legacy-koala detection (drop old-install handling)
items.context: core/managed-assets.ts excluded-path entries bin/koala.js / bin/koala-codex.js / .lattice-codex/koala.json (the denylist for old koala binaries); the @koala-agent old-global-install detection in flow-stability-smoke.ts / worktree-repair-smoke.ts / lattice-only-absence-smoke.ts. Remove the detection and its now-moot absence assertions; no old-koala migration support kept.

happy.desc: git grep bin/koala.js and bin/koala-codex.js in core/managed-assets.ts -> zero hits; the excluded-path denylist entries are removed; WHY: confirms legacy binary denylist is deleted
git grep @koala-agent in packages/*/src -> zero hits; the old-global-install detection logic is gone; WHY: confirms old-install migration detection removed

flow-stability-smoke.ts, worktree-repair-smoke.ts, lattice-only-absence-smoke.ts still compile and pass after removing the @koala-agent absence assertions -> npm test passes for those files; WHY: deletion of moot assertions must not break the rest of the smoke

edge.desc: grep for .lattice-codex/koala.json in managed-assets.ts -> zero hits; WHY: this was part of the denylist alongside the binaries and must also be removed

grep for isKoalaSelfRepoBootstrap in packages/*/src -> zero hits OR renamed to lattice equivalent; WHY: if this function was load-bearing self-repo detection, it must be renamed not silently deleted (story understanding unknown #1)

adversarial.desc: verify that removing the absence assertions did not remove UNRELATED assertions from the same smoke files -- diff the smoke files and confirm only koala-related lines were deleted; WHY: bulk deletion can accidentally strip genuine test coverage

verify managed-assets.ts still has its non-koala excluded-path entries intact after the koala entries are removed -> the array still contains its other legitimate entries; WHY: deleting array entries can cause off-by-one or accidentally remove neighbors

items.title: Clean the remaining koala-codex / koala-agent and stray koala literals in packages/*/src
items.context: The ~7 files with koala-codex/koala-agent references not covered above, plus any other stray koala comment/string in packages/*/src, except the residue-gate self-identifiers (KOALA_RESIDUE_* in handlers/review-preflight.ts) which are story 4.

items.title: Keep build/suite/gate green; confirm zero koala except the deferred gate self-ID
items.context: npx tsc --noEmit clean; packages/main suite green (skip pre-existing fails cli-json-stdout/field-regression/english-open-source-surface/prompt-token-cost); node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs still PASS + self-test. Final: git grep -i koala -- 'packages/*/src/**' returns ONLY review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_* (story 4); zero salts/legacy-detection/koala-codex/koala-agent remain; docs/experiments and .lattice/story untouched.

items.context: ~25 hits: the idleKoala config field, koala.config.json filename references, koalaConfig identifiers in packages/*/src. items.title: Rename .koala/ runtime path references to the lattice runtime dir
items.context: ~22 hits: .koala/ runtime path string literals/comments (e.g. tool-status.ts .koala/activity.jsonl). Point them at the lattice runtime dir (.lattice/ or the canonical path). Under no-compat, existing .koala/ data is NOT migrated (orphaned for any old install; OSS users start fresh). Verify no code still WRITES to .koala/.
